items.name: 7 prompts for trading research
items.summary: Prompts for trade ideas, chart reading, news, backtests, portfolio risk, a trade journal and a daily plan.
items.note: For research and journaling; not financial advice.
prompts: Trade idea generator: Analyse the current market and give 5 high-probability trade setups for [stock / index / sector], with entry, exit targets, stop-loss and risk/reward, and explain why each works using technical and fundamental factors.
Technical analyst: Analyse [ticker] on daily and weekly charts: support and resistance, trend lines, moving averages and momentum indicators. Give step-by-step buy / hold / sell signals with reasons.
News to action: Summarise the latest news on [company / sector] and turn it into trading implications: likely short- and long-term effects, expected price range and suggested positioning.

Strategy backtest: Backtest [strategy, e.g. moving-average crossover or RSI divergence] on [stock / index] over [period]. Report win rate, profit factor, maximum drawdown and ways to improve the edge.

Portfolio risk manager: Analyse my portfolio [tickers and weights]. Point out weaknesses, over-exposure and hidden correlations, and suggest risk-adjusted rebalancing and hedges against a 20% market drop.
Trade journal review: Review my last 20 trades [entries, exits, results]. Find repeated mistakes, missed opportunities and behavioural biases, and give me 3 personal rules to trade more consistently.
Daily trading plan: Design a daily plan for [market / asset]: pre-market analysis, opening strategy, intraday adjustments and closing routine.

items.summary: Blender add-on turning sketches, images and video into 3D assets; agents drive it via MCP.
items.install: Blender 5.0+: Preferences > Get Extensions > Repositories > add `https://blender.scenario.com/repo/index.json`, install Scenario, paste your Scenario API key
